result_summary.title: Staging Payment Gateway: Undercharging and Incorrect Currency Conversion
result_summary.description: We have identified billing discrepancies in the Payment Gateway v2 staging environment (EU-West). Transactions are being undercharged, and the currency conversion rates applied do not match the expected values. This affects 23 test users. We need to correct the pricing logic and currency mapping to ensure that our checkout flows are accurate before moving to production.
